verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents an official MCP server at its mcp-overview page, which agents in Cursor, VS Code, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or OpenCode can connect to. Its MCP agent use case says this works without writing code and without an API key. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the MCP tool surface and auth/transport options in the evidence, and independent hands-on corroboration of the MCP connection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://docs.trychannel3.com/mcp-overview
Connect Cursor, VS Code, Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, or OpenCode.
You can use it without writing any code, and without an API key.
